profile.name: RIEGL VZ-i系列地面激光扫描仪
profile.name_en: RIEGL VZ-i Series terrestrial laser scanner
profile.description: 这是一类用于地面三维测绘与建模的激光扫描仪，可执行扫描、快速扫描、反射片搜索与扫描、位姿估计、图像采集以及点云配准等任务，常用于测量、工程现场记录和空间三维重建。
profile.description_en: A terrestrial 3D laser scanner used for surveying and spatial documentation. It supports scan acquisition, quick scans, reflector target search and scans, pose estimation, image acquisition, and point-cloud registration for measurement, site documentation, and 3D reconstruction.
